confirmed_findings.title: Known part categories and binding limits bypass i18n
confirmed_findings.mechanism: The register and lifecycle card replace underscores in category codes; category options do the same. Bound by interpolates raw binding_limit. These are closed UI vocabulary, unlike user-entered labels/positions/notes or backend narratives. Translating the enclosing label does not translate the enum value.
confirmed_findings.repro: Source scenario, NOT EXECUTED: render cabin_filter with binding_limit=distance under a non-English locale; open Record part. English cabin filter/distance remain in the card, register and options.
confirmed_findings.fix: Localize recognized category/binding labels while retaining API enum values and unknown-code fallback. Request exact missing canonical keys from the serialized catalog owner; do not recase user content.

test_evidence.detail: Existing mobile assertion expects English cabin filter; mocked i18n is not localization acceptance.

confirmed_findings.title: Quality badge renders raw known English status
confirmed_findings.mechanism: quality.status is rendered directly even though sufficient/limited/insufficient have existing ownership.verdict catalog labels and VerdictBadge recognizes them.
confirmed_findings.repro: Source scenario, NOT EXECUTED: supply quality.status=limited and a non-English locale; the quality badge remains limited.
confirmed_findings.fix: Reuse the existing localized known-status mapping/ownership VerdictBadge without changing quality thresholds, tone or raw status.
confirmed_findings.dedupe: Shared EvidencePanel owner; not a separate page-by-page fix.

confirmed_findings.title: Dates bypass saved locale and timezone
confirmed_findings.mechanism: All 18 domain call sites invoke pure formatDateTime without options. dateFormat.ts:44-63 defaults to browser locale/timezone. The existing useDateFormat hook binds saved settings locale and timezone at lines73-93 but is not consumed by these owners.
confirmed_findings.repro: Source scenario, NOT EXECUTED: browser locale en-US/timezone America/Los_Angeles; saved locale de-DE and timezone mode utc. An instant near UTC midnight still uses browser presentation in installed/retired/replacement/history/evidence/freshness displays and filter labels.
confirmed_findings.fix: Adopt existing useDateFormat at these domain callers, preserving source UTC instants, table value identities, null placeholders and independent business-date semantics. Separately resolve candidate CC001 before reinterpreting calendar dates.
confirmed_findings.dedupe: One ownership-domain date integration need for three callers. Completed phase6-fix-advanced-evidence-date-preferences concerns a different feature and is precedent, not acceptance of these files. Do not modify shared dateFormat or reopen its completed owner.

confirmed_findings.title: Initial paused summary is labelled loading rather than paused
confirmed_findings.mechanism: deriveDataState returns initial plus isRefreshBlocked for a no-data paused query. OwnershipBrief checks stale/fatal/hasData but never isRefreshBlocked; isPending selects Loading source and line75 marks the brief loading although fetching is paused. OwnershipPanel separately supplies the correct initial-pause explanation, so two layers disagree.
confirmed_findings.repro: Source scenario, NOT EXECUTED: source={data:undefined,isPending:true,isLoading:false,fetchStatus:paused}, enabled=true. Fleet wear posture/Wear economics show the initial-pause message while their brief status remains Loading source.
confirmed_findings.fix: Distinguish initial paused, unresolved idle and active fetching at the existing brief owner; keep unknown values suppressed/unknown without inventing retained payload or an empty response.

test_evidence.detail: Declared paused coverage only supplies retained data; initial-paused status is not asserted.

confirmed_findings.title: Independent editor masks initial register failure/pause and source retry
confirmed_findings.mechanism: editing && !hasData forces SourceContent ready before fatal/paused/loading checks, and line70 removes errorRecovery. On this page opening Record part keeps the form, but also renders DataTable with items=[] and No parts recorded yet at page894, while the unresolved/failed register loses its local state explanation and retry. Preserving the draft is correct; hiding the independently unavailable read source is not required.
confirmed_findings.repro: Source scenario, NOT EXECUTED: items query has no data and an initial error or fetchStatus=paused; click Record part. Editor remains mounted, but local register retry/state is absent and its table claims no recorded parts.
confirmed_findings.fix: Keep unsaved editor reachable independently while retaining a nonblocking read-source notice/retry and distinguishing unresolved register from authoritative empty. Do not revert to fatal content replacement that deletes the form.

test_evidence.detail: Existing declared editor test explicitly expects Retry to be absent; a source fix needs a narrow additive state/recovery assertion rather than sacrificing draft preservation.

confirmed_findings.title: Old part-create success closes a newer editor context
confirmed_findings.mechanism: submitItem onSuccess unconditionally closes formOpen; unlike submitEvent at203-204 it captures no form activation/revision or vehicle authority. The Record part/Cancel toggle remains usable while create is pending. An old success can therefore close an editor reopened for another vehicle or edited draft.
confirmed_findings.repro: Source scenario, NOT EXECUTED and never perform a real write: with a mocked/deferred create, submit vehicle7 part; cancel, switch to vehicle8 and reopen/edit Record part; invoke the saved vehicle7 success callback. setFormOpen(false) closes the current vehicle8 editor.
confirmed_findings.fix: Give the part form its own activation/context/revision settlement guard. Only the still-owning successful submission may close it; retain later drafts and avoid stealing focus. Reuse the existing event identity pattern where appropriate, without resetting drafts or changing payloads.

test_evidence.detail: Old-success coverage exists for event creation only.
Part-create test checks raw payload but does not settle an old callback after scope/editor changes.

confirmed_findings.title: Record-part disclosure lacks exposed expansion/control relationship
confirmed_findings.mechanism: The toolbar button toggles formOpen but supplies neither aria-expanded nor aria-controls; the controlled form at690 has no stable disclosure target id. Its changing localized Record part/Cancel label does not expose the relationship.
confirmed_findings.repro: Source inspection only: inspect the button and conditionally mounted form at page675-690. No expanded state or target linkage is declared in its props.
confirmed_findings.fix: Add stable locale-independent form identity and localized disclosure state via existing Button/native ARIA. Preserve native form labels, required markers, focus and mobile reachability.

conditional_and_native_candidates.title: Installed-on date becomes a UTC-midnight instant and may display on the preceding local day
conditional_and_native_candidates.mechanism: fromDateInput appends T00:00:00.000Z; toDateInput extracts the UTC day. The installed date column formats the resulting instant in a timezone.
conditional_and_native_candidates.repro: NOT EXECUTED: entering 2026-03-01 produces 2026-03-01T00:00Z, which corresponds to February28 in Los Angeles. Determine whether installed_at is a civil service date or an actual instant before changing it.
conditional_and_native_candidates.needed: Business/backend contract for civil date versus instant and intended timezone. No backend, API or maintenance records accessed.

conditional_and_native_candidates.title: One unbound event draft is reused after part/vehicle changes
conditional_and_native_candidates.mechanism: Closing/cancelling or vehicle mismatch clears eventFor but not eventDraft. Opening another part therefore reuses the previous note/odometer/cost/kind. Existing test explicitly expects a note to survive vehicle7 -> vehicle8. This is not classified as a regression against that declared intention.
conditional_and_native_candidates.repro: NOT EXECUTED: type a vehicle7 part note, switch vehicle, open another part; old note is shown under new target. Submission eligibility does guard the current item/vehicle.
conditional_and_native_candidates.needed: Clarify whether drafts are portable or identity-bound. If identity-bound, retain per-target drafts rather than silently clearing data or weakening the existing preservation test.

conditional_and_native_candidates.title: Log event from Quick view opens an external editor while the modal stays open
conditional_and_native_candidates.mechanism: Quick-view details call allColumns.render, including page row actions. Their Log event callback only sets eventFor; adapter detailKey is not cleared. The shared Modal remains aria-modal and focus-trapped while page effect requests focus on an external heading. Inline mobile row actions do not have this particular modal context.
conditional_and_native_candidates.repro: NOT EXECUTED: narrow table -> Quick view -> Log event. Check actual focus, screen-reader exposure, dialog closure and reachable editor after closing. Do not submit a service event.
conditional_and_native_candidates.needed: Mounted browser/native keyboard and focus evidence under an explicitly authorized synthetic read-only fixture. Existing mobile page test checks actions enabled but never activates Log event inside Quick view.

Installed date, event occurred_at, projected replacement, rolling next12months and lifetime spend are independent business/model dates, not header range; no unsupported backend bounds invented.
preservation.identity: Event target must match current vehicle and current item list membership; old event success cannot close a different item editor. Remove completion checks current vehicle. Item create settlement lacks equivalent authority(CL006). Draft policy is conditional(CC002).
preservation.coverage: Quality sample_count/coverage/window/reasons and evidence retained. allStress first-wins deduplicates by factor.code; whether differently scoped factors can share a code is backend-contract UNKNOWN, not a confirmed defect. Page briefs explicitly say recorded analysis bounds not supplied when no window prop is passed; EvidencePanel separately renders quality observation window. Do not infer model analysis bounds from quality bounds without authority.
preservation.raw_si: Hooks return raw typed payloads; item/event odometers and rated life remain metres; daysToSeconds supplies rated_life_s; monetary values remain ISO minor units. Input hints convert only display; wear cost keeps original1000m denominator.
preservation.signs: formatPct preserves source numeric sign/nonfinite->dash; formatSpan uses explicit sign; monetary helper retains negative source signs. Health clamps only aria-hidden visual width, not health text/cache. Domain nonnegative entry mins are declared, not measured validation behavior.
preservation.unknown_zero: Summary raw missing values remain undefined/null through operational metric validation; actual zero counts/costs retained. Rated/remaining/per-metre unknown values use dash. Numeric form defaults/fallback0 are entered draft semantics, not measured telemetry.
preservation.states: Persistent independent report/items/evidence shells; initial skeleton/unknown summaries, fatal recovery limited to source, retained payload and explicit refresh/pause warning, individual retry. Initial-paused summary and editor read-source gaps recorded as CL004/CL005. Missing selection disables queries and Save; no empty response inferred from a missing hook payload outside the editor gap.
preservation.preferences: Distance/locale/number precision and recorded currency honored through existing units/number/currency display adapters. Saved date locale/timezone bypass recorded CL003. Saved12/24h acceptance not established; current inspected date API uses Intl locale, without an explicit clock-format option. Theme/density/chart/table settings not reset or rewritten.
preservation.i18n: Labels/actions/help mostly use t with fallbacks; event kinds and lifecycle status use known mappings. Five enum-label sites still bypass localization(CL001/CL002). User/backend narratives are not blindly relabelled or recased.
preservation.mobile_a11y: Explicit mobile adapters preserve row actions and full details; forms stack at base; wrapping/min-w0/logical alignment declared. Event form is named by stable useId heading and focus/restore mechanism; native inputs/shared components retain required labels. Decorative bar is aria-hidden with numeric text. Record disclosure lacks ARIA(CL007). Actual geometry/modal-focus/RTL/contrast/keyboard/forced-colors acceptance remains NOTRUN.
preservation.mutation_safety: Audit executes no application writes or mutations. Production source QueryClient mutations retry0/networkMode=always at queryClient67-74 avoids offline replay. Safety/auth/capability/backend acceptance is not proved by these source checks.
